mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 330 (indicating high inflation) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk of monetary tightening and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 330, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 102.5 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 4.0%, it signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.5 AND UNRATE > 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 330 (indicating a monetary tightening cycle) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 3.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 330, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 750000 signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 750000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate above 4.3% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings concerns.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.3, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102.5 for 3 consecutive months) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.5 for 3 consecutive months, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 24170 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 24170, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
